title: OrganisationStructureChangedPayload
description: Payload of the OrganisationStructureChanged event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Authored by INV-T-2853 (T9). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

nodeType.description: Which level of the org tree changed.

nodeRef.description: Identifier of the tenant, group, entity or business unit that changed.

parentRef.description: New parent node reference, present on CREATED and MOVED.

previousParentRef.description: Prior parent node reference, present on MOVED.
